## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL — Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. SPY RECOVERY (1W: +0.38% | 1M: -0.28%) and TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.04% | 1M: +1.07%) show mixed stock/bond signals while broad sector strength (9/11) prevents a clear risk-on or risk-off call.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stable: HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.15% | 1M: +0.30%) and LQD ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +0.53%) — both ↑ rising on the week. Commodities/real assets supportive: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +11.56%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.70% | 1M: +14.81%), while VXX CORRECTION (1W: -0.37% | 1M: +5.51%) shows short-term easing but 1M caution.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-accommodative: TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.04% | 1M: +1.07%) → ↑ rising (bond demand), Dollar shown as neutral in the barometer (flat); overall conditions balanced, not decisively easing or tightening.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Cyclicals leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.70% | 1M: +14.81%), MOO ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +12.82%), XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +9.64%). Lagging: XLY BELOW TREND (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -4.89%) and XLK RECOVERY (1W: +0.33% | 1M: -2.46%) — style: cyclicals over discretionary/tech.

5. US vs Global?
US mixed: SPY RECOVERY (1W: +0.38% | 1M: -0.28%). Global strength constructive: EWJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +10.03%), EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.68% | 1M: +6.06%), FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.09% | 1M: +0.46%) — EM and Japan participation notable.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed: IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.29% | 1M: +2.28%) shows small-cap participation, while ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -10.00%) and IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -10.00% | 1M: -23.83%) signal reduced thematic/crypto risk appetite.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Broad reflation tone: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +11.56%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.46% | 1M: +11.15%) showing strength, while CPER CORRECTION (1W: -3.07% | 1M: +0.50%) and UNG CORRECTION (1W: -6.55% | 1M: +16.63%) show mixed signals across metals/energy.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy clear: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.70% | 1M: +14.81%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.46% | 1M: +11.15%) → ↑ rising; natural gas (UNG) in CORRECTION (1W: -6.55% | 1M: +16.63%) remains volatile.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: Broad sector breadth (9/11) and multiple cyclical ETFs ABOVE TREND (XLE, XLB, MOO). Divergences: Tech/large-cap weakness — QQQ BELOW TREND (1W: -0.82% | 1M: -2.42%) and XLK RECOVERY (1W: +0.33% | 1M: -2.46%) vs TLT ABOVE TREND — mixed signals warrant neutrality.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals and commodity-exposed ETFs showing strength (XLE ABOVE TREND, XLB ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to tech/thematic risk (QQQ BELOW TREND, ARKK BELOW TREND) and monitor bond/gold protection (TLT ABOVE TREND, GLD ABOVE TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Energy XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.70% | 1M: +14.81%), Materials XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.36% | 1M: +9.64%). BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary XLY BELOW TREND (1W: -2.20% | 1M: -4.89%), Technology QQQ BELOW TREND (1W: -0.82% | 1M: -2.42%).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Gold GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.79% | 1M: +11.56%), Oil BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.46% | 1M: +11.15%). BEARISH: Natural Gas UNG CORRECTION (1W: -6.55% | 1M: +16.63%) and Silver SLV CORRECTION (1W: -4.61% | 1M: +1.42%).

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency/watch for upticks), HYG/LQD spread (watch near recent tightness for credit risk), XLK/QQQ downside pivot (monitor QQQ BELOW TREND), SPY support/resilience around recent recovery levels.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL — Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, but mixed stock/bond and risk ratios keep the regime balanced. Cyclicals and commodities (XLE, XLB, GLD) are showing relative strength. Key risk: tech/thematic weakness (QQQ, ARKK, IBIT) amid bond demand (TLT ABOVE TREND) — monitor for rotation or escalation.
